## Markup
```html
<label class="rp-form-control-label"><input type="checkbox" class="rp-checkbox" checked /> Email</label>
<label class="rp-form-control-label"><input type="radio" class="rp-radio" name="format" checked /> DD/MM/YYYY</label>
<div class="rp-form-group rp-form-group-row">… several controls …</div>

<!-- Switch: a button with role switch. Table cells use size small -->
<button type="button" class="rp-switch rp-switch-size-small rp-switch-checked" role="switch" aria-checked="true" aria-label="Active"></button>
<label class="rp-form-control-label"><button type="button" class="rp-switch rp-switch-checked" role="switch" aria-checked="true"></button> Send a reminder after 3 days</label>
```

## Behavior (shared.js)
- Checkboxes inside `.rp-table` select the row; the header checkbox selects all visible rows (partial = `indeterminate`) and shows the bulk bar.
- `.rp-switch` toggles itself on click and fires `change`. Never toggle it again in page JS: listen to `change` (the switch in a row updates its status chip).

## Rules
- Checkbox for several independent choices, radio for one of a few (2–5) visible options, switch for something that applies at once (on / off).
- Never a checkbox or switch without a text or an `aria-label`.
